about.title: About Me
about.content:
MBA Finance candidate with experience in investment banking, equity research, financial modelling, valuation, and M&A analysis through internships at Bank of America, KPMG India, and Paterson Securities.

Skilled in 3-statement, DCF, Reverse DCF, and comparable company analysis, with exposure to due diligence and strategic analysis. Based in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India.

items.title: Equity Valuation: Yes Bank & Pidilite
items.summary: 3-Statement, DCF and Reverse DCF models for valuation and investment analysis of Yes Bank and Pidilite.
items.role: Quantamental Equity Research & Financial Analytics Intern
items.overview:
As part of my equity research internship, I built full valuation models for two Indian companies, Yes Bank and Pidilite, to support investment analysis.

The work combined fundamental modelling with credit and sector views to judge whether each stock was fairly valued.
highlights: Built 3-Statement, DCF & Reverse DCF models for valuation and investment analysis of Yes Bank & Pidilite.
Assessed credit risk, cash flows, leverage & liquidity across companies.
Conducted macroeconomic & sector research to evaluate market and investment implications.

items.title: Quantamental Stock Screening

items.role: Quantamental Equity Research & Financial Analytics Intern
items.overview:
A screening exercise that narrowed a wide universe of Indian companies down to a focused shortlist for deeper research.

It blended numbers-based factors with qualitative judgement, the quantamental approach.
highlights: Screened 58 Indian companies, shortlisting 20 using fundamental, quantitative & qualitative factors.
Shortlisted names fed into the valuation models and sector research.
